extensions.name: hand_left_kpts3d
extensions.description: Left-hand 3D keypoints, flattened [x,y,z,...] for MediaPipe's 21 landmarks (float[63]).
extensions.notes: Shipped by Iris from D-13, registered retroactively as the worked example for this registry (#69). Promoted 2026-07-27; migrate with `python -m mnesis_canonical migrate`.

extensions.name: hand_pose
extensions.description: Concatenated per-frame hand vector (128 floats) with presence flags and zero padding for an absent hand.
extensions.notes: Promoted by being DROPPED: it is a derived projection of observation.hand.*, and its zero padding contradicts the 'absent means unknown' iron rule. Derived shapes belong to the LeRobot exporter, not the wire. See SPEC.md §Hand keypoints.
